info.title: Traigent Backend Agent Posture Routes
info.description: E4 (fleet posture): the manager-set Agent posture write (deployment stage + criticality). The path follows the closest existing agent-readiness write, target-revisions: a project-scoped, per-Agent sub-resource of agent-readiness that creates an immutable revision guarded by expected_current_revision_id and answers a stale form with a const-bodied 409 revision_conflict. The current posture is read through the existing readiness portfolio and detail responses (agent_posture), so no GET is declared here. A separate endpoint module from agent_readiness_endpoints.json, whose path set is pinned by test_endpoint_inventory_registers_project_scoped_read_and_target_routes.

post.summary: Declare or replace the manager-set posture (deployment stage and criticality) of a project Agent
post.description: Human session only, with project owner or admin role. declared_by and declared_at are derived by the server from the authenticated session and are rejected if supplied.

400.description: Invalid posture declaration (unknown key, declared_by/declared_at supplied, deployment_stage or criticality outside its closed vocabulary)

403.description: Posture write denied: not a human session with project owner or admin role (API-key principals are always denied)

404.description: Agent not found in the authorized project scope

409.description: The posture changed since the form was loaded

message.const: This posture changed. Reload the current revision before saving.
